response:
Here are three sentences with 15 characters each, incrementally indented:

    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.
    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.
    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.

And here's a screenplay comparing the sky after a grueling hike and the sky outside a gas station in the city:

FADE IN:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see a rundown gas station in the outskirts of the city. The sign reads "Eddie's Eats" and the building looks like it's been there for decades.

CUT TO:

EXT. SUMMIT - DAY

We see a hiker, JEN (30s), standing at the summit of a mountain, arms raised in triumph. The sky is a brilliant blue, with not a cloud in sight.

JEN
(voiceover)
I did it! I finally made it to the top!

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see the same gas station, but this time it's at sunset. The sky is a deep orange, with a few wispy clouds scattered about.

JEN (V.O.)
But then I realized, the view from the top of the mountain wasn't that different from the view from the top of this gas station.

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see a car driving up to the gas station, and a sign on the side reads "Eddie's Eats - Home of the Best Gas in Town".

JEN (V.O.)
I mean, sure, the view from the summit was pretty, but it was also kind of... boring. I mean, have you seen the view from the top of this gas station? It's like the whole city is spread out before you like a giant, dirty puzzle.

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see a group of shady-looking characters hanging out outside the gas station, eyeing the cars that drive by.

JEN (V.O.)
And the people-watching? Forget about it. You've got your truckers, your bikers, your... well, you've got your Eddie's Eats regulars, who are basically just a bunch of guys who like to drink and complain about the government.

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see Jen, looking out at the view, shaking her head.

JEN (V.O.)
I guess what I'm saying is, the view from the top of the mountain wasn't that different from the view from the top of this gas station. But hey, at least the gas station has a view.

FADE OUT.
